title: CrowdStrike Falcon Event Stream connector (Beta)
body:
The CrowdStrike Falcon Event Stream connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

The connector ingests Falcon Event Stream events from CrowdStrike Falcon into Databricks. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials from a CrowdStrike API client with Event streams Read permission.

See [CrowdStrike Falcon Event Stream connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/crowdstrike-falcon-event-stream).
